serialization.notes: Each method payload restores identical outputs; block-shift buffer is stored as 64 int8 indices. Kernel bank, biases, method, dimensions, shifts, seeds, and metadata are included in torch.save payloads.

notes: Targeted prior-art search covered BCA, generalized structured matrices, compact spectral circulant/BCCB layers, MAP, and Hadamard binding.
Learning rate 0.01 was selected on both development seeds by the preregistered all-method/all-condition mean-MSE metric before fresh access.
Block-shift Mirror passed registered quality and actual-byte gates in all three fresh aligned worlds.
The independent block-circulant baseline was a strong storage/quality control; block-shift used 21% fewer bytes with similar quality.
Measured eager runtime was substantially slower. MAC proxy assumes FFT block execution and does not establish actual latency improvement.
Fixed-update aligned synthetic evidence; no capacity or language-model claim.
